feature_contract.goal: Prevent original gameplay HUD/clip SpriteNodes from inheriting incorrect binocular semantic ownership across VR toggles, queue render or external-overlay reentry; retain valid direct owners and native fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Direct native put_sprite_ex/put_sprite_ex2 source-to-live-queue path only; do not change gameplay timer, original FFB/input, SkyGlow, UV restoration, R26_SAFE, DX11 or frozen DXVK. Optical output is not HMD-proven.
trace_stages: Original EXE direct E8 caller enters native sprite hook; collect VR enable state and current producer/queue/external semantic scope before native call.

Native put_sprite_ex/put_sprite_ex2 can reenter another queue/external callback or observe VR mode transitions before returning; compare with original entry conditions, then apply the pre-existing stable-root bounded live tail proof.

Only consistently admitted native SpriteNodes gain exact scope/producer tags; R84 R30/R33 GPU owner/admission and x64 OpenXR host remain independently responsible for eye submissions; fallback is unchanged.
subcomponents: Capture VR mode at native sprite source entry and reject tags on VR off-to-on or on-to-off transitions.
Reject queued, external overlay and changed producer/scope state across native callback, preserving known-good stable HUD and unknown native fallback.
Include source-header Win32 static assertions and executable C++ regression for stable, toggled, nested, queued, overlay and registration-generation cases, with final exact-SHA Gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Direct HUD sprites under stable VR ownership keep original eye semantic, but desktop-to-VR transition or changed parent cannot gain binocular label.
Both VR transition directions, queued rendering, external overlay and producer/scope changes reject wrong tags while existing valid direct source remains admitted.
Windows R84 game, R26_SAFE fallback, x64 host/package, Domain, EXE HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact all pass same validation-bearing SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: TagDirectVrSpriteNodes read only Settings::VREnabled after original native callback; queue/overlay changes only restricted diagnostic producer token, not wrong render scope registration.
diagnosis.root_cause: Native game callback may change VR mode and render source before captured SpriteNodes are registered; return-only check can misclassify desktop or foreign HUD children as stereo owned.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally promote unknown UI or bypass live tail proof.
Do not declare fixed optical visuals before Quest3/VDXR runtime.

ci_evidence.local_targeted_gate: C++ compile-time negative regression in game owner; portable native-source fixture staged
